priorBaseline: schemaVersion 1 (Phase 2 first baseline) — all 4 paths variance exceeded threshold, registered as path C upgrade candidates

1-voucher-posting.dataScale: 1000 vouchers per round (single businessType AP_INVOICE; multi-type mix is successor refinement)
1-voucher-posting.seedProfile: 1 batch x 1000 unique PostingEvents pre-built outside timing window; per-round state reset (delete voucher+line+billR outside timing window) so each round scans same table size
1-voucher-posting.notes: Per-round state reset eliminates systematic dataset-growth (Phase 2 root cause #1). Residual variance 187% is GC-dominated: 1000-voucher batch post = ~30s allocation-heavy operation (4000+ inserts/round), major GC pauses (multi-second) unavoidable within timed window. GC hint between rounds counterproductive (shifts GC into timed window, tested 218%). JMH fork isolation counterproductive (DB-bound end-to-end, design doc §3.4 line 125). ABSOLUTE-TOLERANCE FALLBACK: median ~31s stable enough for >5x regression detection; nightly relative-median-diff 20% gate (LATEST.json) operates on stable nightly medians regardless of per-round variance ratio. Phase 2 baseline median 23000ms -> stabilized 31198ms (reset delete overhead + H2 churn from delete+reinsert, acceptable; regression semantics preserved).

2-period-close.target: IErpFinAccountingPeriodBiz.closePeriod (preCheck + AR/AP/INV/AST/GL module close + FX reval + PL transfer + trial balance)
2-period-close.dataScale: 6000 GL lines (3000 vouchers x 2 lines) per period; period reverse-close + close cycle per round
2-period-close.seedProfile: Seed period + subjects + 3000 posted vouchers + 1 open AR-EUR (for FX reval); per-round reset: finalize->reverseClose (untimed) before next close
2-period-close.stabilizationStrategy: scale-increase (2000->6000 GL lines, escape sub-50ms jitter floor)
2-period-close.notes: Scale increase 2000->6000 GL lines WORKED: median 32ms->133ms escaped sub-50ms jitter floor, variance 43.7%->5.39% WITHIN <20% threshold. Absolute jitter (~7ms range) constant regardless of scale, so relative variance ratio drops as median grows. close+reverseClose per-round reversal-pair accumulation <1% at 6000 GL line base (negligible). Adjudicated 6000 (not 10000): H2 localDb seed time constraint; 6000 sufficient to escape jitter floor. Phase 2 baseline median 32.377ms -> stabilized 133.248ms (3x scale, expected linear).

3-inv-reclose.target: IErpInvCostingBiz.reclosePeriodCosts (scan DONE FIFO moves + recompute missing cost layers + flush)
3-inv-reclose.dataScale: 500 incoming moves x 20 FIFO materials (all missing cost layers); reset cost layers per round
3-inv-reclose.seedProfile: Seed 20 FIFO materials + period + subjects; costing-off generates 500 DONE incoming moves (no layers); per-round reset: delete all cost layers + GC hint (untimed) before next reclose
3-inv-reclose.stabilizationStrategy: per-round-costlayer-reset (Phase 2 already in place, confirmed) + gc-hint (heap-state stabilization)
3-inv-reclose.notes: Per-round cost-layer reset (Phase 2) confirmed + GC hint added. Residual variance 115% is inherent H2 in-memory query jitter: reclose issues 500x~4 queries (moves/lines/ledgers/layers) per round -> ~2000 queries/round; H2 in-memory query time has high variance. JMH fork isolation REVERSED from §4.3 'most likely candidate' hypothesis: Phase 2 evidence shows reclose is DB-I/O-bound (not CPU-bound), §3.4 line 125 applies (JMH fork rebuilds DB connection/cache -> cold query plans -> MORE variance). ABSOLUTE-TOLERANCE FALLBACK: median ~649ms stable, nightly relative-median-diff 20% gate effective. Data scale adjudicated 5000->500 moves / 50->20 materials (generateMove full pipeline ~50-100ms/move makes N=5000 seed >500s).

4-report-render.target: ErpFinReportBizModel.renderHtml per report (6 reports: balance-sheet / income-statement / cash-flow-statement / ar-ap-aging / period-close-report / budget-vs-actual)
4-report-render.dataScale: 1 report per measurement; 6 reports independently measured (K=2 warmup + N=10 timed each)
4-report-render.seedProfile: Seed period + 6 subjects + GL balances + 1 posted voucher + 1 open AR + period status + 2 bill-R; reuse for all 6 reports
4-report-render.stabilizationStrategy: absolute-tolerance-metric (sub-ms inherent, scale increase rejected: aggregation masks per-report anomaly)
4-report-render.notes: Sub-millisecond render: (max-min)/median amplifies tiny absolute jitter. Absolute ranges 0.16-0.90ms confirm timing stable for >5x regression detection. METRIC ADJUDICATION: variance ratio retained for RECORD ONLY; regression gate uses absolute median (nightly relative-median-diff 20%, LATEST.json). Scale increase rejected: aggregating multiple renders masks per-report anomaly (design doc §4.4), and single report render remains sub-ms regardless. Design doc §4.4 note confirmed: 'absolute timing stable enough for >5x regression detection'.

summary.path2Verdict: WITHIN THRESHOLD (scale increase 2000->6000 GL lines, variance 43.7%->5.39%)
summary.jmhUpgradeAdjudication: NOT INTRODUCED for any path. All 4 paths DB-bound (1/2/3) or sub-ms (4); none CPU-bound. Design doc §3.4 line 125 (JMH counterproductive for DB-bound) + Phase 2 evidence (reclose DB-heavy not CPU-bound, §4.3 hypothesis reversed). Path C successor hook (§9) remains open for future CPU-bound path.
summary.overallVerdict: Path 2 stabilized to within threshold via scale increase. Paths 1/3/4 variance inherent (GC/H2-jitter/sub-ms) -> absolute-tolerance fallback adjudicated: medians stable, nightly relative-median-diff 20% gate (LATEST.json) effective for regression detection. Baseline usable for per-path regression gating via stable medians; variance ratio retained as reproducibility record.
